readme:
# GH FastPass Automatically dismiss GitHub Mobile's 2FA verification dialog after approval.

## Overview Every time you approve a 2FA push notification in the GitHub app, a "Verification request approved" dialog blocks the screen until you tap CLOSE. This module removes that friction by hooking the dialog's Compose state machine and finishing the activity as soon as the approval completes.
StockPatched
## Requirements - Android 10 (API 29) or higher - An LSPosed Manager version with API 101 support (required for now) - GitHub mobile app (`com.github.android`) > [!NOTE] > Tested with GitHub Mobile `v1.249.1`. Other versions should work as long as GitHub doesn't restructure the 2FA dialog internals. ## Install 1. Download the APK: 2. Enable the module in LSPosed and scope it to `com.github.android` 3. Force-stop the GitHub app and relaunch ## Build ```bash git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/hxreborn/gh-fast-pass.git cd gh-fast-pass ./gradlew buildLibxposed ./gradlew assembleRelease ``` Requires JDK 21 and Android SDK. Configure `local.properties`: ```properties sdk.dir=/path/to/android/sdk # Optional signing RELEASE_STORE_FILE= RELEASE_STORE_PASSWORD= RELEASE_KEY_ALIAS= RELEASE_KEY_PASSWORD= ``` ## License This project is licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0. See the [LICENSE](https://github.com/hxreborn/gh-fast-pass/blob/main/LICENSE) file for details.

# GH 快速通行证 批准后自动关闭 GitHub Mobile 的 2FA 验证对话框。

## 概述 每次您在 GitHub 应用程序中批准 2FA 推送通知时，“验证请求已批准”对话框都会阻塞屏幕，直到您点击“关闭”。该模块通过挂钩对话框的 Compose 状态机并在批准完成后立即完成活动来消除这种摩擦。 <表> 库存已修补 ## 要求 - Android 10 (API 29) 或更高版本 - 支持 API 101 的 LSPod Manager 版本（目前需要） - GitHub 移动应用程序 (`com.github.android`) > [!注意] > 使用 GitHub Mobile `v1.249.1` 进行测试。只要 GitHub 不重构 2FA 对话框内部结构，其他版本就应该可以工作。 ## 安装 1.下载APK： <一href="http://apps.obtainium.imranr.dev/redirect.html?r=obtainium://app/%7B%22id%22%3A%22eu.hxreborn.ghfastpass%22%2C%22url%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fhxreborn%2Fgh -fast-pass%22%2C%22author%22%3A%22rafareborn%22%2C%22name%22%3A%22GH%20FastPass%22%2C%22additionalSettings%22%3A%22%7B%5C%22includePrereleases%5C%22%3Afalse%7D%22%7D"> 2. 在 LSPod 中启用该模块并将其范围设置为 `com.github.android` 3. 强制停止 GitHub 应用程序并重新启动 ## 构建 ````bash git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/hxreborn/gh-fast-pass.git cd gh-快速通行证 ./gradlew buildLibxpose ./gradlew assembleRelease ```` 需要 JDK 21 和 Android SDK。配置`local.properties`： ````属性 sdk.dir=/路径/到/android/sdk # 可选签名 RELEASE_STORE_FILE=<路径/to/keystore.jks> RELEASE_STORE_PASSWORD=<商店密码> RELEASE_KEY_ALIAS=<密钥别名> RELEASE_KEY_PASSWORD=<密钥密码> ```` ## 许可证 该项目根据 GNU 通用公共许可证 v3.0 获得许可。有关详细信息，请参阅 [LICENSE](https://github.com/hxreborn/gh-fast-pass/blob/main/LICENSE) 文件。
